title: Arkret Realm Join Intake
description: Join discovery and bootstrap through the verified current governance Station. An inviter Station and Directory provide only routing hints; neither is an authority source.

authority_locator_hints.description: One to eight untrusted locator cores, strictly sorted by service_id UTF-8 bytes. service_id is the semantic identity key; duplicate or conflicting representations of one service_id invalidate the entire array.

governance_generation.description: Station tenure the intake descriptor was answered under.

self_preview_outcome.description: Pre-join disclosure relayed by the caller's own Station. authority_bundle is the RealmAuthorityBundle that Station fetched with its own nonce and verified before asking the current governance Station for the preview; the preview is not membership, a join commitment or verified governance state.

peer_preview_outcome.description: Disclosure answered by the verified current governance Station. It carries no authority bundle: the caller Station has already verified this Station through its own nonce-bound RealmAuthorityBundle and authenticates it as Destination-Service-ID.

self_prepare_outcome.description: Current context for authoring a producer-signed join Event. It does not reserve a position or authorize admission.

membership_commit_id.description: RealmCommit of the member's own join that opened the caller's held stream, or re-anchored it after the caller had no joined hosted member left: ak.member.state{join} or ak.invite.accept for a directed Invite on the Realm stream, or ak.circle.member.state{join} on the Circle stream. Circle bootstrap requires current parent-Realm membership; a parent-Realm join Commit cannot replace the Circle join Commit (zh/sync/federation.md section 4.1.1).

peer_bootstrap_outcome.description: The verified current authority returns a snapshot whose retention_and_history_floor for the membership Commit's exact stream is that join position, with a visible head at or above it. Other authorized streams retain their own history floors. The caller verifies that prefix evidence, installs the disclosed snapshot current_state_entries as its typed current anchored at their stream heads, then scans each permitted stream from its own floor to its advertised head (zh/sync/federation.md section 4.1.1). After an already accepted registered atomic unit has completed member-station materialization, a governing Snapshot refresh preserves that caller's canonical history floor proved under zh/governance/history-visibility.md section 3.1 and its complete authorized current cut. Under since_join, floor zero requires the exact current founding join and position zero to belong to the same proven accepted atomic unit, with its complete originals and continuous Commit chain; later rejoin, missing originals, Realm purpose or low position alone cannot supply this exception. Direct Conversation four-item founding is never four independent single-join bootstrap exceptions. This clarification does not change the initial ordinary single-join bootstrap prefix, Circle gates, signatures, governance tenure, exact scope, membership or continuous-prefix verification, and adds no operation or DTO.
